messages:
laura (support): hi @carla, auditor flagged missing KMS/api access logs for acct `acct-842` between 2025-05-03T00:00Z and 2025-05-04T12:00Z, says SOC2 evidence packet shows gaps
carla (auditor): correct — we received a sample where request_ids are missing for a few hours, need chain-of-custody, export of raw logs, and verification checksums :pray:
ben (eng-security): ok — can you paste the exact sample rows they received or attach the sample? we need to map request_ids to our ingestion pipeline
laura (support): pasted below (redacted):
```
request_id: r-9a3f
timestamp: 2025-05-03T04:12:10Z
action: kms:Encrypt
status: MISSING
```
laura (support): auditor included a screenshot, uploaded to the ticket: https://redwood.tickets/INC-4521
priya (infra): I can run an S3 export of the raw KMS event bucket and the API gateway access logs for that window. i'll kick off export and post path.
auditor-bot: export job started (job_id=789045), target: s3://redwood-audit-exports/INC-4521/2165001234/ , ETA ~12m
ben (eng-security): good — once export is ready we need: 1) raw files, 2) md5 checksums for each file, 3) minimal repro steps to surface same missing row if it's ingestion-related, 4) mapping from file -> downstream index (bigtable/bq)
carla (auditor): for SOC2 we also need a short statement on retention policy and whether any retention policy change happened in April/May 2025. please include config snapshots and PR refs if applicable.
matt (sre): confirmed retention policy was unchanged in prod. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/retention-config/commit/4f8a2c (last update 2024-11-12)
priya (infra): export finished: s3://redwood-audit-exports/INC-4521/2165001234/ ; files: kms_events_20250503.gz (md5: 3b5d9f2a...), api_gateway_20250503.gz (md5: a7c1e8d4...); uploaded to internal transfer, generating signed link now
laura (support): sharing signed link to auditor portal (do not re-upload publicly): https://secure.redwood/audit/packets/INC-4521/2165001234
ben (eng-security): quick log query to check for the missing request id in our indexed store:
```
SELECT request_id, event_time, action, status
FROM `redwood-logs.kms_index.events`
WHERE request_id = 'r-9a3f'
AND event_time BETWEEN '2025-05-03T00:00:00Z' AND '2025-05-04T12:00:00Z'
```
ben (eng-security): result: no rows in index. we'll verify raw S3 shows the event or not. if raw S3 has it but index doesn't, it's an ingestion gap; if raw S3 also missing, upstream service didn't emit it.
priya (infra): I grepped the uncompressed export locally and found one line with that request_id in KMS raw: `2025-05-03T04:12:10Z r-9a3f kms:Encrypt SUCCESS` — so raw event exists
matt (sre): then ingestion pipeline likely dropped it. tagging @ben for tracing. can we repro locally?
ben (eng-security): yes, steps to reproduce ingestion dropout locally:
1) fetch sample file: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-exports/INC-4521/2165001234/kms_events_20250503.gz ./`
2) run the ingestion shim in dry-run: `./ingest-shim --input kms_events_20250503.gz --check-mapping`
3) inspect logs: `grep r-9a3f ingest-shim.log`
ben (eng-security): in my local run I saw a transient parse exception on newline boundaries which is fixed in a pending patch (PR 5123). if that patch wasn't deployed around 2025-05-03 it could explain dropouts.
carla (auditor): please include the PR id and deploy timeline in the evidence packet. auditor needs to see whether change windows overlap the gap
laura (support): adding timeline: PR 5123 merged 2025-04-29, patched into staging 2025-04-30, prod rollout 2025-05-06 (so after incident window).
carla (auditor): that timeline is concerning — please provide compensating controls or confirmation that missing rows aren't systemic across customers
ben (eng-security): we'll run a sampling check across 10 random customer buckets for the same window and compare raw -> index counts. i'll attach a small script and results.
priya (infra): sampling script output uploaded: https://secure.redwood/audit/packets/INC-4521/2165001234/sampling_results.csv (counts show 99.96% match, single missing row found only for acct-842)
carla (auditor): ok that helps. still need chain-of-custody: please provide file-level checksums, signed manifest, and an admin note that logs haven't been tampered with.
matt (sre): Uploaded manifest with file hashes and admin attestation: https://secure.redwood/audit/packets/INC-4521/2165001234/manifest.json
ben (eng-security): packaging evidence packet: components = [raw exports, index query outputs, sampling_results.csv, manifest.json, PR 5123 diff & deploy notes, reproduction steps]. ETA to handoff to auditor: 2025-05-20 18:00Z
laura (support): i'll notify auditor and mark ticket INC-4521 as "evidence provided" once ben confirms final bundle. :white_check_mark:
carla (auditor): thanks — please also include retention policy snapshot and the scheduled retention delete job logs around the window, auditor needs to see delete jobs didn't run accidentally
priya (infra): attaching delete-job logs and scheduler snapshot to the packet now
ben (eng-security): final note — we'll also add an internal postmortem draft to explain root cause (ingestion parse issue + rollout schedule) and mitigation (reprocess missing rows, change rollout cadence, add file-level ack checks). will update when PM draft is ready.
laura (support): ack, ping me when it's uploaded and i'll close the loop with the customer
carla (auditor): received, thanks everyone. we'll review the evidence and post any follow-ups by 2025-05-27
